maintenance_led.reason: Sells new Flexitouch, Nimbl and AffloVest at-home therapy devices to patients first-time via prescription, not repair or aftermarket work.

publicly_funded.reason: Devices are mostly reimbursed by commercial insurers and Medicare Advantage mix, with Medicare and Medicaid a minority share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own Flexitouch, Nimbl and AffloVest devices; only occasional acquisitions such as AffloVest.

mission_critical.reason: Prescribed compression devices are replaceable by competing pneumatic compression devices or garments; switching needs a new prescription but is not core infrastructure.

notes: Payer mix and switching difficulty are not stated on the website; answers rely partly on general knowledge.
